findings.highlight: that person must have been able to build a more peaceful country
findings.evidenceJa: 平和な国を長く築けたのではないか
findings.governingReading: might that person have built a peaceful country that endured
findings.explanation: Saber’s counterfactual question becomes certainty about a better reign.

findings.highlight: everything she has taken away
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女が奪った多くのモノ
findings.governingReading: the many things she had taken away
findings.explanation: A large but bounded moral burden becomes totalized.

findings.highlight: Her master continued to appeal in his pain
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みにのたうちまわりながら、彼女の主は訴え続けた
findings.governingReading: Her Master kept pleading his case while writhing in pain.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s violent bodily suffering is reduced to an abstract condition.

findings.highlight: She continued to refuse him
findings.evidenceJa: 頑なに拒み続けた
findings.governingReading: She had continued stubbornly refusing him.
findings.explanation: Saber’s rigidity is omitted from her self-critique.

findings.highlight: does she only wish to make that destruction never have happened
findings.evidenceJa: 私はただ、あの滅びを無かった事にしたいだけなのか
findings.governingReading: Do I merely want to erase that ruin?
findings.explanation: Saber’s direct first-person self-interrogation is flattened into third-person narration.

findings.highlight: That the heaviness in her heart would go away as well
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を抉った、残酷な重さ
findings.governingReading: the cruel weight that gouged the chest
findings.explanation: Violence, cruelty, and bodily metaphor are omitted.

findings.highlight: salvation by elimination
findings.evidenceJa: この上ない赦し、消去による自己の救罪
findings.governingReading: supreme forgiveness: self-absolution through erasure
findings.explanation: The religious and self-directed structure of the temptation is reduced to generic salvation.

findings.highlight: all the things taken away
findings.evidenceJa: 奪われた全ての想い
findings.governingReading: all the feelings, hopes, and attachments that had been taken away
findings.explanation: Human inward experience is generalized into things.

findings.highlight: She has taken away many things and killed many
findings.evidenceJa: 私は多くの物を奪い、多くの死を重ねてきた
findings.governingReading: I have taken many things and accumulated death upon death.
findings.explanation: Saber’s direct confession becomes detached narration and narrows the accumulating-deaths image to killing people.

findings.highlight: To bear the pain and regret it is the requiem
findings.evidenceJa: その痛みに耐え、悔いる事が、失われたものへの鎮魂に他ならない
findings.governingReading: Enduring and regretting that pain is itself requiem for what was lost.
findings.explanation: The object and exact identity of Saber’s mourning act are weakened.

findings.highlight: she is no longer a king
findings.evidenceJa: 王としての資格はない
findings.governingReading: she no longer has the qualifications/right to act as king
findings.explanation: Loss of standing after the country’s fall becomes erasure of Saber’s identity as king.

findings.highlight: The girl pulled the sword out believing so
findings.evidenceJa: それを承知で、あの少女は剣を執った
findings.governingReading: The girl took up the sword knowing and accepting all of that.
findings.explanation: Conscious acceptance of the cost becomes an unspecified belief.

findings.highlight: Something she has kept to herself
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に抉られた一つの言葉
findings.governingReading: a single phrase gouged into her chest
findings.explanation: A violent remembered utterance becomes private information.

findings.highlight: Even if it meant losing everything and fighting everything
findings.evidenceJa: みんなにきらわれることになったとしても
findings.governingReading: even if it meant being hated by everyone
findings.explanation: The social cost of kingship becomes universal combat.

findings.highlight: Even if the result was her destruction
findings.evidenceJa: たとえ結末が滅びであろうとも
findings.governingReading: Even if the ending was ruin.
findings.explanation: The nation’s ruin or disastrous outcome is reassigned specifically to Saber’s destruction.

findings.highlight: Let her end the dream that was never granted
findings.evidenceJa: 叶わなかったこの夢を、最後まで見続けよう
findings.governingReading: At least I will continue dreaming this unfulfilled dream to the very end.
findings.explanation: Saber’s resolve to sustain the dream is reversed into ending it.

findings.highlight: I said I favor Shirou more than that thing
findings.evidenceJa: 私はシロウが欲しい
findings.governingReading: I said that what I want is Shirou, more than such a thing.
findings.explanation: Saber’s direct personal desire is weakened into comparative preference.

findings.highlight: her role is already determined
findings.evidenceJa: 私の役割は決まっている
findings.governingReading: my role is settled
findings.explanation: Saber’s owned first-person resolve is again converted to third-person narration.

findings.highlight: the dream the girl Arturia wished for
findings.evidenceJa: ただ一度のとうといユメ
findings.governingReading: the one precious dream seen by the girl Artoria
findings.explanation: Singularity and preciousness are omitted, while “saw/dreamed” becomes wished for.

findings.highlight: She confessed that she no longer needs such a thing
findings.evidenceJa: 迷いのないその言葉
findings.governingReading: those unhesitating words declaring that she needs no such thing
findings.explanation: The absence of hesitation completing Saber’s decision is omitted.

findings.highlight: I take her hand
findings.evidenceJa: 囁く声に応えて、セイバーの手を握る
findings.governingReading: Answering her whispered voice, he grips Saber’s hand.
findings.explanation: The whispered intimacy and Shirou’s responsive agency are omitted.

findings.highlight: Energy starts to flow into my weak body
findings.evidenceJa: 失血で朦朧としていた頭に、段々と活力が戻ってくる
findings.governingReading: Vitality gradually returns to his head, dazed by blood loss.
findings.explanation: The precise cognitive recovery and its cause become energy entering a generally weak body.

findings.highlight: underground temple
findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂
findings.governingReading: sanctuary/chapel
findings.explanation: The church sanctuary is again mislabeled as a temple.

findings.highlight: you must die here, Emiya Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: おまえたちにはここで死んで貰わなくてはならなくなった
findings.governingReading: I now have to ask the two of you to die here, Emiya Shirou.
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s death sentence for Shirou and Saber is narrowed by English address to Shirou alone.

findings.highlight: Gilgamesh, appearing suddenly
findings.evidenceJa: 悠然と現れたギルガメッシュ
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh, appearing with leisurely composure
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s unhurried dominance is replaced by suddenness.

findings.highlight: the temple
findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂
findings.governingReading: the sanctuary/chapel
findings.explanation: The church interior is mislabeled as a temple.

findings.highlight: We shared the same feelings
findings.evidenceJa: 意見を同じくして
findings.governingReading: we came to share the same view/opinion
findings.explanation: Strategic or ideological agreement becomes emotional affinity.

findings.highlight: Lancer is by the stairs, and Gilgamesh is standing in the temple
findings.evidenceJa: 地上へ続く階段にはランサーが、聖堂にはギルガメッシュが立ち塞がった
findings.governingReading: Lancer blocks the stairs to the surface, while Gilgamesh bars the sanctuary.
findings.explanation: Both enemies’ active obstruction of escape is reduced to location.

findings.highlight: Do not doubt me
findings.evidenceJa: 人聞きが悪いな
findings.governingReading: You make me sound bad.
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s ironic concern for appearances becomes a direct command to trust him.

findings.highlight: I ordered Archer to stay here
findings.evidenceJa: 待機を命じていた
findings.governingReading: I had ordered Archer to remain on standby.
findings.explanation: An unsupported location is added to Kotomine’s order.

findings.highlight: I did not lie to you at all
findings.evidenceJa: 何一つとしておまえを謀ってはいまい
findings.governingReading: I have not deceived or schemed against you in a single respect, have I?
findings.explanation: Kotomine narrows the accusation from manipulation to literal falsehood.

findings.highlight: As if asking about the crime of the disaster ten years ago
findings.evidenceJa: 十年前の惨事の罪を問うように
findings.governingReading: as though demanding who bears guilt for the disaster ten years ago
findings.explanation: Responsibility for the disaster becomes an oddly objectified “crime of the disaster.”

findings.highlight: It only spilled onto Archer
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーはそれを浴びてしまっただけ
findings.governingReading: Archer merely ended up being bathed in it.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s passive exposure is rendered with misplaced “only” modifying the spill.

findings.highlight: it will kill everything around it
findings.evidenceJa: 周囲の人間を悉く殺害し
findings.governingReading: it will kill every person around the owner
findings.explanation: Human victims are broadened into all surrounding things.

findings.highlight: That magical vessel
findings.evidenceJa: あの底なしの魔力の釜
findings.governingReading: that bottomless cauldron of magical energy
findings.explanation: The image of limitless depth and the cauldron form are omitted.

findings.highlight: Is the Holy Grail not something that will grant any wish to its possessor
findings.evidenceJa: 持ち主の望み通りに世界を変革するのが聖杯
findings.governingReading: the Grail was meant to transform the world according to its owner’s desire
findings.explanation: A precise world-transforming function is replaced by a generic wish-granting formula.

findings.highlight: a fluctuation dependant on the plundering of the weak. It is the most efficient fluctuation
findings.evidenceJa: つまりは弱者からの略奪による変動だ。それこそが、最も効率のよい変革だろう
findings.governingReading: change produced by plundering the weak—the most efficient transformation
findings.explanation: Deliberate social transformation is reduced to repeated technical “fluctuation.”

findings.highlight: This is the true identity of the omnipotent power
findings.evidenceJa: それがマスターとサーヴァントに与えられる、万能の力の正体か
findings.governingReading: Is that the true nature of the omnipotent power?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s horrified realization remains interrogative in Japanese but becomes objective exposition.

findings.highlight: A poisoned vessel
findings.evidenceJa: この上ない毒の壺
findings.governingReading: the ultimate/supreme jar of poison
findings.explanation: A thing that is itself maximally poisonous becomes a vessel that has merely been poisoned.

findings.highlight: a true curse
findings.evidenceJa: 際限のない呪いの塊
findings.governingReading: a limitless mass of curses
findings.explanation: Scale, plurality, and physical aggregation are omitted.

findings.highlight: this Holy Grail exists to kill everything
findings.evidenceJa: 人を殺す為だけの聖杯
findings.governingReading: a Holy Grail existing solely to kill people
findings.explanation: Its stated human target is broadened to everything.

findings.highlight: it is like a dream
findings.evidenceJa: 天上の夢でも見ているかのようだ
findings.governingReading: it is as though he were dreaming a heavenly dream
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s ecstatic religious register is omitted.

findings.highlight: A laugh from the bottom of his heart… a holy laugh without any evil
findings.evidenceJa: 心からの感謝を表す、邪気のない聖者の笑み
findings.governingReading: an innocent saint’s smile expressing gratitude from the heart
findings.explanation: The disturbing collision of sincere gratitude and saintly facial innocence becomes a vaguely “holy” laugh.

findings.highlight: I cannot let him have the Holy Grail over anyone
findings.evidenceJa: 他の誰よりも、この男に聖杯など与えてはならない
findings.governingReading: More than anyone else, this man must never be given the Holy Grail.
findings.explanation: The comparative judgment identifying Kotomine as the worst possible owner becomes malformed.

findings.highlight: The only ones left are me, and the two Servants
findings.evidenceJa: 傷ついて満足に動けない自分
findings.governingReading: himself, wounded and unable to move properly, with the two Servants
findings.explanation: The physical constraint governing escape is omitted from the scene inventory.

findings.highlight: And Saber, standing as if to guard me, glaring at her enemies
findings.evidenceJa: 決死の面持ちで敵を見据えるセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber faces the enemy with the look of one resolved to die.
findings.explanation: The mortal determination in Saber’s expression is omitted.

findings.highlight: We have to defeat Lancer and Gilgamesh
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーとギルガメッシュを振り払わなければならない
findings.governingReading: They must shake off/get past Lancer and Gilgamesh.
findings.explanation: The escape objective is changed into defeating both Servants, immediately contradicting the next line.

findings.highlight: I’ll do my best to follow you
findings.evidenceJa: 意地でも付いていく
findings.governingReading: I will keep up even if sheer stubbornness is all I have.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s unconditional stubborn commitment becomes an attempt whose success is uncertain.

findings.highlight: runs to the temple
findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂へと躍り出た
findings.governingReading: leaps out into the sanctuary
findings.explanation: The church setting and the explosive motion are both weakened.

findings.highlight: Gilgamesh’s longsword
findings.evidenceJa: それに続く筈だったギルガメッシュの長剣
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh’s longsword, which should have followed against its assigned target
findings.explanation: The coordinated expected second attack is omitted, obscuring why both Shirou and Saber are surprised.

findings.highlight: I’m not gonna obey him
findings.evidenceJa: オレは降ろさせてもらうぜ
findings.governingReading: I will be withdrawing/bowing out.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s unilateral exit from Kotomine’s service becomes only refusal of one command.

findings.highlight: I’m not nice enough to listen to his orders
findings.evidenceJa: おいそれと命令を聞くほど良くできた人間じゃねえ
findings.governingReading: I am not so well-made/compliant a man that I will readily obey after this contempt.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s pride and refusal to be docile become a claim about niceness.

findings.highlight: the oaths we couldn’t fulfill
findings.evidenceJa: 果たせなかった未練
findings.governingReading: the lingering regrets/desires we could not bring to completion
findings.explanation: Heroic unfinished attachments are narrowed to sworn promises.

findings.highlight: Weapons appear in empty space
findings.evidenceJa: 次々と無数の武器が現れていく
findings.governingReading: countless weapons appear one after another in empty space
findings.explanation: Number and accumulating sequence are omitted from the Gate of Babylon image.

findings.highlight: Don’t think I’m on your side just because I protected you
findings.evidenceJa: 庇った程度で仲間意識持ちやがって
findings.governingReading: Do not start acting like a comrade merely because I covered for you.
findings.explanation: Lancer rebukes Saber’s emerging comradeship; English instead denies Lancer’s allegiance.

findings.highlight: the confrontation underground escalates without limit
findings.evidenceJa: 地下の両者は対峙を止めなかった
findings.governingReading: the two below never ceased facing one another
findings.explanation: Continued poised confrontation becomes limitless escalation, borrowing intensity from the following killing-aura sentence.

findings.highlight: The murderous intent continues to grow
findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂に満ちていく殺気は、際限なく濃く深くなっていく
findings.governingReading: The killing intent filling the sanctuary grows without limit in density and depth.
findings.explanation: Location and the suffocating density image are omitted.

findings.highlight: I cannot stay idle if I want the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を呼ぶ為にはそういう訳にもいかん
findings.governingReading: But to summon the Holy Grail, I cannot allow matters to remain that way and spare Saber.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s conflict between possession and sacrifice becomes generic impatience.

findings.highlight: The golden knight grins
findings.evidenceJa: 口元が歪に歪む
findings.governingReading: The golden knight’s mouth twists grotesquely.
findings.explanation: An ominously distorted expression becomes a generic grin.

findings.highlight: we leave that place
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちは階段を上りきった
findings.governingReading: they reach the top of the stairs
findings.explanation: A precise escape milestone becomes generic departure.
